) -> float:
    # Stern judging norm: cooperation is appropriate only if the recipient has a good reputation (>= 0).
    appropriate = (recipient_reputation >= 0 and donor_action == 'cooperate') or \
                  (recipient_reputation < 0 and donor_action == 'defect')
    # Move reputation smoothly towards +1 (appropriate) or -1 (inappropriate)
